notes.title: Claw Staff has released!
notes.notes: Claw Staff is finally available on Steam! Thanks to everyone who helped get me to this point. Hopefully I'll sell a few copies. If you find any bugs, let me know in the discussions on the Claw Staff hub. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Pricing.
notes.notes: As I forget to include this in the last post, it gets its own special announcement! Claw Staff will be $4.99/£3.99. Pricing other currencies may vary.

notes.title: Claw Staff will release on July 18th!
notes.notes: Yes, I know I've missed several release dates, but this time its definitely happening. Claw Staff is releasing on Thursday July 18th! This is the end of a long road of learning how to program and then making an actual game. I'm rather excited.
